title: Syrian Lentil Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Chinese-inspired dish made with lentils, pilaf, and spices.

ingredients.name: Lightly spiced oil
ingredients.notes: Vegetable or peanut oil with a light blend of spices

instructions: Heat lightly spiced oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger; cook for an additional minute.
Add cooked pilaf and stir to combine with the onion mixture.
Add rinsed and drained lentils; stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Add low-sodium soy sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the lentils are heated through.
Garnish with sesame oil and serve.
